commands.name: Set-OfficeWordImage
commands.synopsis: Updates OfficeIMO Word image sizing, wrapping, crop, and metadata.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordPageSetup
commands.synopsis: Sets page setup options on Word sections.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordParagraph
commands.synopsis: Updates paragraph style, spacing, indentation, and pagination hints.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordShape
commands.synopsis: Updates OfficeIMO Word shape metadata, sizing, and colors.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordTableCell
commands.synopsis: Updates native Word cell text, physical geometry and layout flags.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Sets properties on a table of contents in a Word document.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Updates styling on Word text.

commands.name: Set-OfficeYamlNode
commands.synopsis: Sets the value at a path in a live YAML document, creating missing mappings on the way.

commands.name: Split-OfficeDocument
commands.synopsis: Splits PDF files into consecutive groups, selected ranges or top-level bookmarked chapters.

commands.name: Stop-OfficePrintJob
commands.synopsis: Cancels a print job submitted with Send-OfficePrinter and returns its state afterwards. Requires PowerShell 7.4 or newer.

commands.name: Test-OfficeAccessibility
commands.synopsis: Checks Word, Excel and PowerPoint files for accessibility issues. The input is never changed.

commands.name: Test-OfficeDocument
commands.synopsis: Validates native document structure, schema, security, accessibility or compliance without changing the input.

commands.name: Test-OfficeExcelTemplate
commands.synopsis: Tests whether supplied values bind every template marker.

commands.name: Test-OfficePdfAccessibility
commands.synopsis: Checks a PDF against PDF/UA-1 using the Matterhorn Protocol failure conditions.

commands.name: Test-OfficePdfRewrite
commands.synopsis: Creates a proof report for user-visible signals preserved by a PDF rewrite.

commands.name: Test-OfficePowerPoint
commands.synopsis: Inspects a live or saved presentation without changing or reopening a supplied document.

commands.name: Test-OfficeToml
commands.synopsis: Tests whether TOML files or text load, without changing them.

commands.name: Test-OfficeYaml
commands.synopsis: Tests whether YAML files or text load, without changing them.

commands.name: Unprotect-OfficeDocument
commands.synopsis: Removes native package encryption or selected editing restrictions.

commands.name: Unprotect-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Removes worksheet protection.

commands.name: Update-OfficeExcelComment
commands.synopsis: Replaces the text or author of notes that match a filter.

commands.name: Update-OfficeExcelText
commands.synopsis: Replaces text in cell values across a workbook, sheet or range.

commands.name: Update-OfficePdf
commands.synopsis: Flattens forms or annotations, or adds a searchable OCR text layer, writing a new PDF.

commands.name: Update-OfficePowerPointText
commands.synopsis: Replaces text in the selected slide or document, including tables by default.

commands.name: Update-OfficeRtfText
commands.synopsis: Applies lossless text and metadata edits to an RTF document.

commands.name: Update-OfficeToml
commands.synopsis: Applies a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) or JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) to a live TOML document.

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordField
commands.synopsis: Updates fields in a Word document.

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Updates the table of contents in a Word document.

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Replaces text in a Word document.

commands.name: Update-OfficeYaml
commands.synopsis: Applies a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) or JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) to a live YAML document.
